positive.prompt: Add structured logging and crash reporting to the checkout flow in the app
Set up tracing so we can follow a request from the app across services
What alerts should we page on for the new app release?

negative.prompt: Draft the PRD for the referral program

evals.prompt: Instrument the new payment-retry feature in the app so on-call can operate it.
evals.expected_output: On-call questions defined first, then structured events with app-version tagging, crash and error reporting, and symptom-based alerts that answer them
expectations: On-call questions are written before instrumentation is added
Logs are structured events with a correlation id and app version, not print statements or prose strings
Card numbers, emails, and raw gateway responses are kept out of logs and telemetry
Metrics and analytics avoid unbounded label cardinality and respect consent
Failures are reported so they can be found by app version, and alerts are symptom-based and actionable
